lines.zh: 八条腿踩在洞壁上，几乎无声。
lines.en: Eight legs on the cave wall, nearly silent.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，网却铺得很快。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my webs spread fast.

lines.zh: 洞顶的裂缝我钻得过去。
lines.en: I can squeeze through cracks in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 腹部拖在地上，留下丝痕。
lines.en: My abdomen drags, leaving a thread of silk.

lines.zh: 石缝里的虫，都认得我的脚步。
lines.en: The bugs in the cracks know my step.
I keep to the wall, never the middle.
My eight legs move like a shuttle.

lines.zh: 我听见滴水，就往那边去。
lines.en: I hear dripping and head that way.
Do not step on the thread behind me.
The cave is dark; that suits my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的腿毛蹭过岩面，沙沙响。
lines.en: My leg hairs rasp over the stone.
Each step lays down a length of silk.
I head deeper, where it is damper.

lines.zh: 孩子们跟在后面，很安静。
lines.en: The little ones follow behind, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里侧着身子过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and pass through the rock gap.

lines.zh: 洞底的水洼，我踩过去不响。
lines.en: The puddle on the cave floor makes no sound under me.
I cling to the ceiling, waiting for lights out.
The silk sways gently by my feet.
My abdomen pulses, heavy with eggs.

lines.zh: 我不织网，我只是把它挂好。
lines.en: I do not weave much; I hang the web.

lines.zh: 洞里安静，我听得见你的呼吸。
lines.en: The cave is quiet; I hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 八只眼都半闭着，仍看得见。
lines.en: All eight eyes half closed, still watching.
I count the little ones and lose count.
In the dripping dark I grind my fangs.
The damp makes my silk stickier.
I tuck my legs and look like a stone.
A moth hit the web; I hold still.
My eggs are all in my abdomen; do not touch.

lines.zh: 我四只眼盯你，四只看别处。
lines.en: Four eyes on you, four watching elsewhere.
I dislike the torch in your hand.
You have broken my silk.
Do not stand on that web; it sticks.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，也有汗味。
lines.en: You smell of iron and of sweat.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在试你的距离。
lines.en: My head tilts as I test your distance.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾满了我的网。
lines.en: Your boots are covered in my web.

lines.zh: 我看见你身后的洞口了。
lines.en: I see the tunnel mouth behind you.

lines.zh: 别往下看，下面是我的卵。
lines.en: Do not look down; my eggs are below.
You blinked, and I came closer.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了一点，不碍事。
lines.en: A crack in my shell, nothing more.

lines.zh: 打我的时候，孩子们会出来。
lines.en: Hit me and the little ones come out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了几条腿。
lines.en: That cost me a couple of legs.
I do not cry out; spiders do not.
You stepped on my abdomen.
The silk broke; I can spin more.
It hurts, but I will not lose the eggs.

lines.zh: 再打，洞里会挤满小蜘蛛。
lines.en: Hit me again and the cave fills with young.
My legs tremble, and it is anger.

lines.zh: 这一击，我记在你的位置上了。
lines.en: I have marked where that blow came from.
Give me that bug in your hand.
Rotten flesh is fine; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 晃动的线，比食物更吸引我。
lines.en: A swinging string tempts me more than food.

lines.zh: 你把虫放地上，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Set the bug down and I will come over.
Do not crush it; I want it alive.

lines.zh: 洞里没吃的，我饿了很久。
lines.en: Nothing in this cave; I have hungered long.
That raw meat still has wet blood.
Come a little closer; I might not reach.
I take the food but not the hand.

lines.zh: 丝一动，我就知道有吃的。
lines.en: One tug on the silk and I know food is here.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，被黏住了。
lines.en: You bumped my leg and stuck to it.
I am heavier; you are the one moving.
Do not pull that thread; it holds the roof.
My leg hairs sting; be careful.
You stepped on the web; now you slow.

lines.zh: 撞开我，也撞开了一窝小蜘蛛。
lines.en: Push me aside and you scatter a nest of young.
My shell is hard; your shoulder is soft.

lines.zh: 别挤在洞口，那儿是我下脚的地方。
lines.en: Do not crowd the mouth; that is where I step.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你的靴子就归我了。
lines.en: One touch and your boot belongs to me.
I moved back because a thread snapped.
I ate my partner long ago.
I keep the eggs, not the company.

lines.zh: 他来过一次，然后就没了。
lines.en: He came once, and then he was gone.

lines.zh: 洞里那堆丝，是他留下的。
lines.en: That pile of silk is what he left.

lines.zh: 我产卵时，谁也不许靠近。
lines.en: No one comes near while I lay.

lines.zh: 同族相遇，先比谁的孩子多。
lines.en: We meet and compare brood sizes first.

lines.zh: 伴侣要有大一点的腹部。
lines.en: A partner would need a bigger abdomen.

lines.zh: 我不寂寞，洞里全是孩子。
lines.en: I am not lonely; the cave is full of young.
After mating, the silk pulls tighter.

lines.zh: 他若回来，我就再吃一次。
lines.en: If he returns, I will eat him again.
This bone will cushion the eggs.

lines.zh: 我勾住掉落的下颚，收起来。
lines.en: I hook the fallen mandible and keep it.
The silk bundle is mine; do not touch.
I even take pebbles to weight the web.
Your dropped leather will line the nest.
I lift the meat with my front legs.
The egg sac cannot be lost; I counted.

lines.zh: 捡东西时，我八只眼都盯着你。
lines.en: While I pick it up, all eight eyes stay on you.
This loose thread is left from my weaving.

lines.zh: 碎甲片能挂在网边当响铃。
lines.en: Armor chips hang on the web like bells.

lines.zh: 你踩进网里，就算进来了。
lines.en: You stepped in the web; now you are in.
I chose you because you are the loudest.
Poison first, the slowness after.
You can dodge me, not the silk.

lines.zh: 洞里只有一条路，我堵住了。
lines.en: One way out of this cave, and I block it.

lines.zh: 你一抖，整张网都在报位置。
lines.en: One twitch and the whole web reports you.

lines.zh: 活茧裹住你，你就动不了。
lines.en: The living cocoon wraps you, and you stop.
I am patient; the venom waits for you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在洞口，我听见了。
lines.en: Your friend is at the mouth; I hear them.
Dropping from above is faster than chasing.

lines.zh: 洞里全是我的丝，你逃不掉。
lines.en: The cave is all my silk. You can't flee.
Your legs are already slowing.
Two more steps and the venom takes hold.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，丝越缠越多。
lines.en: I circle you and the silk gathers.
Cut the silk and I spin more.
The torch lights me and I do not back off.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越急，我越高兴。
lines.en: The faster you breathe, the happier I am.
I wait for the venom to finish its round.

lines.zh: 别靠墙，那儿也有我的丝。
lines.en: Do not near the wall; my silk is there too.
This bite is only the beginning.
My fangs sink in and you slow.
I bite once and back off to wait.
My legs pin you so my mouth can work.

lines.zh: 我的牙先把毒送进去，疼在后头。
lines.en: My fangs send the venom first; the pain comes later.
Your armor seam is just right for biting.
The bite will go numb soon.
I hold on until your knees give.

lines.zh: 别挣，挣得越快毒走得越快。
lines.en: Do not struggle; it only spreads faster.
Your blood is warm; very good.

lines.zh: 我咬完会退，等你再慢一点。
lines.en: I bite and retreat until you slow more.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下来，丝还连着。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling, still on silk.

lines.zh: 这洞穴够深，适合养孩子。
lines.en: This cave is deep enough to raise young.

lines.zh: 网的第一个角，我系在这里。
lines.en: I tie the first corner of the web here.
It is damp under the stone; just right.
Who lit a fire at the cave mouth?
The moment I arrive, the insects go quiet.

lines.zh: 腹里的卵在动，快到时候了。
lines.en: The eggs stir inside me; it is almost time.
A small web first, then I widen it.

lines.zh: 别拿剑对着我，先看看头顶。
lines.en: Do not point that sword; check above you first.
I come down on a thread of my own.
The fire caught my silk and it all went up.
I fell and broke one leg.

lines.zh: 水灌进书肺，我发不出声。
lines.en: Water floods my lungs and I cannot hiss.
The blast tore my web apart.
The arrow struck my abdomen, near the eggs.

lines.zh: 八条腿一齐僵住，我挪不动。
lines.en: All eight legs lock at once, and I can't move.
The cave is empty; not a bug left.
Thunder shakes every thread at once.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有墙，我织不了网。
lines.en: No walls in the void; I cannot weave.
